description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of Project Management and Monitoring
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The post of Director General of the Department of Project Management and Monitoring is currently vacant due to the appointment of Mr. S.S. Mudalige, who served as the Director General of the Department of Project Management and Monitoring, to a Post of Deputy Secretary to the Treasury. The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to appoint Mr. S.H.V. Kumara, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, presently serving in a Post of Additional Director General of the Department of Development Finance, to the said post, with immediate effect.
